text: “Very near luxurious stay with stunning views. Clean and neat. Well maintained rooms. Morning royal breakfast dishes are available in the buffet. Pure vegetarian fine dining is available. Well maintained atmosphere around the palace hotel. Evening dinner is also so good.“
name: Karthik Pandian G
title: Nivara Palace, Udaipur

text: “We had a fantastic stay at Nivara! From the immaculate rooms to the outstanding hospitality, everything was top-notch. The highlight was the incredible royal thali—absolutely delicious! Special thanks to Vyshakh for going above and beyond to make our stay memorable. Highly recommend this place!“
name: Jinosh KM
title: Nivara Haveli, Jaipur

text: “Good hotel good food super lunch and it's a five star experience. Very near and serene location in Udaipur. Very good restaurant serving veg food and lots of good choices running full time. This is from the family of Nivara group of hotels”
name: Sindhu Rajesh
title: Nivara Palace, Udaipur

text: “We had our lunch from Kesar Restaurant inside Nivara Haveli. The royal thali lunch was too good. The restaurant is clean and the staff were good as well.”
name: Hari Krishnan
title: Nivara Haveli, Jaipur

text: “Nivara Fort is a superb property located conveniently with desert fort views. The rooms were large, clean, and very well-maintained, and the bathrooms were equally spotless. The white linens added to the pristine ambiance, making the stay very comfortable.”
name: Sasikiran
title: Nivara Fort, Jodhpur

text: “An excellent hotel.. I would say the best in Jaisalmer.. Well appointed rooms catering to different guests.. Has all amenities required for a luxury desert stay..”
name: Dinesh L
title: Nivara Dunes, Jaisalmer

text: “The in-room dining arrived warm, beautifully presented, and exactly when promised. The filter coffee and breakfast made our morning feel effortless.”
name: Meera Nair
title: In-room dining guest

text: “A thoughtfully curated vegetarian menu with enough choice for our whole family. The paneer tikka and biryani were particular favourites.”
name: Rahul Menon
title: Family stay

text: “Ordering was simple and the team was very attentive to our dietary preferences. Everything felt polished, personal, and genuinely hospitable.”
name: Ananya Rao
title: Weekend guest

text: “The South Indian thali was comforting and generous without feeling heavy. A lovely meal after a long day of travel.”
name: Vikram Iyer
title: Business traveller

text: “We appreciated the fresh ingredients, clear menu, and careful packaging. The food felt restaurant-quality even in the room.”
name: Priya Krishnan
title: Nivara guest

text: “From the first call to the final delivery, the service was warm and professional. The team made a late family dinner completely stress-free.”
name: Arjun S.
title: Family stay

text: “The menu balances familiar comfort food with lighter choices really well. Our salad, pasta, and dessert were all excellent.”
name: Neha Thomas
title: Leisure guest

text: “Breakfast arrived right on time and the appam with vegetable stew was memorable. Exactly the calm start we wanted.”
name: Sanjay Pillai
title: Morning dining guest
